text:
- Normalize input: treat input as a string; convert to lowercase for uniform vowel matching; handle empty string returning 0.
- Define vowel set {'a','e','i','o','u'} and count occurrences across the string; additionally treat 'y' as a vowel only if it is the last character in the original word (case-insensitive).
- Implement counting via iteration or sum over characters; add tests covering: basic vowels, uppercase handling, words ending with 'y' vs internal 'y', no vowels, all vowels, single-letter cases ('y', 'a'), and mixed punctuation/spaces ignored or explicitly disallowed per spec (decide to count only letters).
